higgs_structural_scale_finding.interpretation: Observed Higgs residual (~0.10%) matches the natural SAM scale alpha_H / R^3 (0.1157%) to within ~10 percent of the scale itself, but the agreement is within 1 sigma of published centrals -- compatible with structural account, not separately required.  HL-LHC tightening to sigma <= 50 MeV resolves the question.
